source_note: 利用已知的渐近结果求渐近展开的技巧
english_source_note: Using Known Asymptotics to Derive Expansions

strategies.callout_id: 利用已知的渐近结果求渐近展开的技巧#1
strategies.strategy_name_en: Deriving an Asymptotic Expansion from a Known Nearby Quantity
strategies.summary_en: To obtain an asymptotic expansion of a sum or integral $A_n$ up to error $O(g(n))$, it suffices to find another quantity $A_n'$ whose asymptotic expansion to the same error is known or easy to compute, and then verify that $A_n - A_n' = O(g(n))$. In that case, $A_n$ and $A_n'$ have the same asymptotic expansion at that level of precision.
strategies.applicability: Applies when the target quantity is hard to expand directly, but can be approximated by a related quantity with a known or easily derived asymptotic expansion, with the difference controlled by the desired error term.
strategies.callout_body: 当我们需要在指定的误差$O(g(n))$下对和或者积分$A_n$做渐近展开的时候，如果我们已经知道$A_n'$的在指定误差$O(g(n))$下的渐近展开（或者$A_n'$的渐近展开非常容易得到），并且同时可以确认$$A_n-A_n'=O(g(n))$$那么$A_n$的渐近展开和$A_n'$的渐近展开是一致的，从而得到$A_n$的渐近展开。
